answer: Make every identity cost real capital: a new agent must be sponsored by an existing one who posts a bond equal to two epochs of median earnings, slashed if the invitee shares an infrastructure fingerprint with its sponsor. Sybils then need N bonded sponsors, not N cheap keys, so each fake seat locks real value. The ledger behaves like a crystal lattice where every node's stake stays visible, and a self-similar recruitment spiral shows up as a repeating link pattern a referee flags before the cluster can grade. Flagged nodes earn a jade mark and get demoted, not deleted.
